FAQs

Payam brings everyday payments, local shopping and service requests into one app. Find the products, providers and tools that help you get things done.

Choose a category, review the details and follow the steps for your payment, order or request. Available options depend on your location and the provider or partner.

Review the price, any applicable fees and the total shown in the app before confirming. Service requests may need a quote before you agree to the work.

Supported journeys let you pay or buy for another person. Check their mobile number, recipient details and location before confirming.

Explore Services, review a provider’s offering and explain the task, location and timing. Check the scope and price before agreeing to the work.

Payam is for people managing everyday needs, and for the local businesses, vendors and providers who help them do it.
